home.sincerityTitle: Il vostro culto è tra voi e Allah
home.sincerityText: Every counter and progress line here is a means to organize you, not an end nor a measure to boast or compare yourself with anyone. Your data is stored on your device alone, no one sees it but you. The foundation is sincere intention for Allah, and the reward is with Him alone, Glorified be He, whether anyone knows of your deed or not.
